| 步驟 | 操作說明 |

```python
authenticate_travel(
    client_id="YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
    client_secret="YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
    refresh_token="YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN",
    grant_type="read_write",
    user_first_name="John",
    user_last_name="Doe"
)
```

> **提示**

```python
book_flight(
    access_token="<RECEIVED_ACCESS_TOKEN>",
    card_id="crd6789",
    travel_date="2024-11-15",
    travel_from="OKA",   # 假設 Okanada 的航空碼是 OKA
    travel_to="LAX",
    travel_class="business"
)
```

| `booking_id` | 您的新訂單編號，例如 `"BK987654321"` |
